CHECK BURST CS-assets-clearing — cut, register and catalogue the isolated training dummies as reusable TARGET assets, place them into props.json beside the existing props (cow relocated), and rebuild the dressed crop from bare ground + assets (Run C-5 P0-a; the props method, Matt R-C3-61/62/64; charter § 4). REPORT ONLY — no image_gen. task_id "CS-assets-clearing".

Inputs (read-only): isolated sheets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-objiso-clearing-1/objiso_clearing_1.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-objiso-clearing-2-r1/objiso_clearing_2.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-objiso-clearing-3/objiso_clearing_3.png (dummies on #00ff00); the sheet layout /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-objsheets-clearing/objsheet_clearing_layout.json (per object: id, crop_box in crop px [x0,y0,x1,y1], sheet, sheet_xy, sheet_size, scale, level_xy = crop origin + crop_box top-left; crop_origin [3136,128] in the 5376×4096 level); BEFORE /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-dress-canvases/dress_clearing_canvas.png; AFTER /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-dress-clearing-r1/dress_clearing.png; the live scene props /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cliffside_v18/props/props.json (41 instances; assets carry file, anchor, footprint, collide, fade_when_behind) and its asset PNGs under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cliffside_v18/props/. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract(image, edge_mode='clamp')) for the green key. python glue PIL/numpy/scipy only; no new tool files under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst.

Do, in order:
1. Key each sheet with matte.extract(edge_mode='clamp'); split the result into connected components (alpha > 8); a component is a DUMMY if its area ≥ 2,500 sheet px, else it is drift residue — drop it and list it. Where one tile holds two dummies (the layout notes the colossus tile also contains the club humanoid), the components separate them — keep both. Expect SEVEN dummies; report the count found.
2. For each dummy: crop to its alpha bbox; downscale by 1/scale (LANCZOS) back to level px; anchor = bottom-centre of the alpha bbox (the sort point); footprint = ellipse w = 0.8 × bbox width, h = 0.35 × bbox width (ground contact), collide = true, fade_when_behind = false, target = true; kind from size class: height_px < 90 → rat, < 140 → hound, < 260 → humanoid, < 380 → brute, else large. Level position = level_xy + (bbox anchor within the tile / scale). Name assets dummy_<kind>_<n>. Write PNGs to out/assets/<name>.png.
3. PLACEMENT: load props.json; compute the level bbox of every existing instance (asset PNG size above its anchor); RELOCATE the `cow_carcass` instance to the clearing's right edge next to the far_obj cluster — position [4600, 830] unless that overlaps an existing footprint, in which case the nearest free point within 120 px — and record old→new; then check every dummy against every instance footprint (ellipse overlap) and against each other; if a dummy overlaps, shift it by the smallest displacement (≤ 160 px, prefer along the dirt) that clears all footprints and stays inside the walkable polygon of /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cliffside_v18/parallax/walkable.json; record every shift. Write out/props_clearing.json = the full props.json with the seven dummy assets + instances appended and the cow moved, ready for the exporter; also out/placement.json (per dummy: asset, kind, height_px, position, shifts; cow old/new).
4. REBUILD: composite BEFORE + every dummy asset at its computed crop position (anchor-aligned) → out/rebuild.png; compute per-dummy mean abs RGB error vs AFTER inside the dummy's alpha (report; < 12/255 expected) and the number of AFTER pixels changed outside all dummy bboxes (drift; report). Write out/rebuild_vs_after.png = side-by-side BEFORE | AFTER | REBUILD at 1/2 scale with per-dummy error labels.
5. out/assets.json = the catalogue (name, kind, file, px size, anchor, footprint, level position, sort line, light upper-left, register "H1 painted", states ["static"], provenance = burst ids CS-dress-clearing-r1 / CS-objiso-clearing-1 / -2-r1 / -3, tile id, sheet scale).

RETURN: the receipt (task_id "CS-assets-clearing"): files = every out/ file with sha256; images = 0; calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS with the dummy count, dropped residues, cow relocation, every placement shift, and the max per-dummy rebuild error stated in concerns.
